name: gbrain
one_liner: A self-hosted memory system that remembers facts for your AI assistants and shares that same memory across ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor instead of each one forgetting everything between chats.
buyer: A solo founder or small consulting team running multiple AI tools who wants one shared memory instead of re-explaining context to each tool every day.
business_use_cases: A consulting firm sets up GBrain as a shared 'company brain' so every client-facing agent pulls from the same vetted facts instead of re-learning context each session.
A solo founder self-hosts GBrain to keep one persistent memory across ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor so none of their AI tools forget project history between sessions.
An agency offers 'AI memory setup' as a paid onboarding service, installing and configuring GBrain for clients who are tired of repeating themselves to their AI tools.

money_ideas.idea: Paid setup and configuration service for teams adopting a shared AI memory
Managed hosting and maintenance retainer for a client's self-hosted brain

steal_this: Install GBrain for one client this weekend as a 'give your AI tools a memory' setup service, charging a flat setup fee plus a small monthly retainer for upkeep.
